description: For the account's owner: the unsigned setSpender(key, perPayment, perDay, expiry) transaction, so a separate key on the agent's machine can pay x402 APIs from the account within those limits (setting a key again replaces its limits), or with remove: true, removeSpender(key). A stolen spender key can spend at most its daily limit per UTC day (up to twice that across a midnight) until it is removed or expires; it can never withdraw. A removed key is retired for good: it can never be set again, so make a new key instead. Make the key on your own machine and send only its address.

days.description: Days until the key expires, 1 to 3650; 30 when left out.

perDayUsdg.description: Most USDG per UTC day, like "5".

remove.description: true removes the key instead: it is retired for good.

name: pay_account_spender_transaction
title: Mercatura Pay: set or remove a spender key
